title: Natural derived affine comparison on all K-flat labelled models
statement: For a commuting coordinate square [def-pc-affine-coordinate-comparison-data] and a K-flat module complex M, invert the fixed derived-pullback counit [lem-pc-perfect-hom-cochain-counit] on the concrete chart model [lem-pc-affine-coordinate-module-models] and compose it with localization of the inverse underived comparison [lem-pc-affine-coordinate-tensor-comparison]. Conjugate by the supplied chart model isomorphisms to obtain H_b(EφM)≅Lp*(H_aM). This is natural for every morphism between K-flat complexes, including all morphisms between the two Boolean-labelled models. Consequently these components define a simultaneous AffineCoordinateComparisonFamily.

proof.text: Concrete coordinate models are K-flat, so the fixed counit is invertible. Construct the isomorphism by composing the localized inverse homotopy comparison and the inverse counit; conjugate by the supplied chart model isomorphisms.

Apply inverseCounitModelNaturality and conjugateComparisonNaturality to prove naturality between any two K-flat models. Restrict to the full induced category on the Boolean labels, supplying the relevant K-flat proof by cases on each label. This preserves arbitrary cross morphisms.
